description: Used by the artifact card to load the live numbers for a chart or report it shows. Not for direct use: call query_insights_report to query a report.

chartPath.description: The report or chart file the artifact's page draws, relative to the artifact folder.

fileId.description: The artifact's .artifact folder ID, as create_artifact, update_artifact or list_files returned it; never an embedded report file ID.

forceRefresh.description: Skip the cached result and run the query again.

queryId.description: The report card's query, for a report file; omitted for a chart file.

scope.description: The report's current filters, such as its date range and site domains.

isProjectDefault.description: Marks an automatically seeded project domain, not a viewer selection.

name: run_artifact_chart
title: Run artifact chart
